facts.fact: Cameroon's higher-education minister inaugurated the Centre d'Incubation des Innovations et des Entreprises Digitales of the Inter-State University Congo-Cameroon on 13 March 2025, a FCFA 450 million CEMAC FODEC-funded building offering student-entrepreneurs support, with four startups presenting projects, and no cohort programme stated.
